lead_editorial.title: Ramlila Maidan ki bheed ne sawaal bada kar diya hai — ab jawaab naaron se nahi, aankdon se aana chahiye
lead_editorial.summary: 13 crore se zyada naam voter list se hatne ka maamla kisi ek party ka mudda nahi raha. Chunav Aayog ko poora hisaab saamne rakhna chahiye, aur vipaksh ko bhi 'jail' jaise vaadon ki jagah saboot par tikna chahiye.
body: Ravivaar ko Ramlila Maidan mein vipakshi INDIA bloc ki rally ne yeh saaf kar diya ki voter list ki samiksha (SIR) ab sirf adaalat ya press conference ka vishay nahi rahi. Reuters ke mutabik 2025 se ab tak 13 crore se zyada naam hataaye ja chuke hain — inmein 2.8 crore mrit, 6.3 crore sthaanantarit aur 3 crore 'untraceable' bataaye gaye. Itne bade paimaane par badlaav par sawaal uthna loktantra mein sehatmand baat hai, chahe sawaal koi bhi uthaaye.

Chunav Aayog ka kehna hai ki yeh prakriya duplicate aur ayogya entries hataane ke liye hai, aur galti se kate log dobara naam judwa sakte hain. Yeh tark apni jagah sahi ho sakta hai, par bharosa tabhi banega jab Aayog rajya aur kshetra-vaar aankde, hataane ke kaaran aur dobara judne ki sankhya khud saarvajanik kare. Reuters ke anusaar September mein Indian Express ne report kiya tha ki CEC ke do sahyogiyon ne andar hi andar chintaayein uthaayi thin — aise mein chuppi sabse kamzor jawaab hai.

Vipaksh ko bhi apni bhasha par dhyaan dena hoga. Rahul Gandhi ka yeh kehna ki CEC 'jail jaayenge', ya Kharge ka sarkar ko 'vote chori' se bani bataana, raajnaitik aarop hain jinhe abhi kisi adaalat ya jaanch ne sabit nahi kiya. Sanvaidhanik sanstha ke mukhiya ko hataane ka raasta sansad aur adaalat se hokar jaata hai; maidan ki bheed dabaav bana sakti hai, faisla nahi de sakti.

Sarkar aur BJP ke liye bhi sabak hai. Pradarshankaariyon ko 'araajak' kehna ya bina saboot videshi haath ka ishaara karna masle ko thanda nahi karega. Agar prakriya saaf hai, to use saaf dikhaane mein koi nuksaan nahi. Behtar yahi hoga ki Supreme Court mein lambit yachikaaon ki sunwaai ke saath Aayog ek swatantra audit ka prastaav khud rakhe — taaki voter list par jhagda sadak se hatkar saboot ki mez par aaye.

stories.title: Ramlila Maidan se Rahul Gandhi ka elaan — 'Gyanesh Kumar ko CEC pad se hataya jayega'; Kharge bole, 'Modi jaayenge tabhi loktantra bachega'
stories.summary: INDIA bloc ki 'Chalo Dilli' rally mein Rahul, Kharge, Akhilesh aur Mamata ne SIR aur Chunav Aayog par tikha hamla bola. Congress ne laakhon ki bheed ka daava kiya; BJP ne ise 'political drama' kaha.
body: Vipakshi INDIA bloc ne Ravivaar ko Delhi ke Ramlila Maidan mein voter list ki Special Intensive Revision (SIR) aur Mukhya Chunav Aayukt Gyanesh Kumar ke khilaaf badi rally ki. ThePrint ke live blog ke mutabik Lok Sabha mein Netaa Vipaksh Rahul Gandhi ne kaha ki Gyanesh Kumar ke bina na Narendra Modi PM bante, na Amit Shah Grih Mantri. Prothom Alo ki report ke anusaar Rahul ne daava kiya ki Kumar ko pad se hataya jayega aur jail bheja jayega; PTI ke hawaale se Inshorts ne unka yeh bayaan bhi diya ki iske baad 'agla nishaana PM Modi' honge. Yeh sab raajnaitik aarop hain, jinki kisi jaanch ne pushti nahi ki hai.

Congress adhyaksh Mallikarjun Kharge ne Centre aur Maharashtra, Bihar, UP ki BJP sarkaron par 'vote chori' se jeetne ka aarop lagaaya aur kaha ki Modi ke jaane par hi loktantra bachega. Samajwadi Party pramukh Akhilesh Yadav ne maidan ko 'loktantra ki Haldighati' bataaya, jabki TMC ki Mamata Banerjee ne kaha ki Bengal SIR ka shikaar hua hai aur ladaai loktantrik tareeke se jaari rahegi. Shashi Tharoor ne CEC se istifa maanga. Congress neta Kumari Selja ne laakhon logon ke pahunchne ka daava kiya; Delhi Police ne pehle kareeb 50,000 ki taiyaari ki thi.

AP ke mutabik Chunav Aayog aur sarkar aaropon ko khaarij karte hain aur kehte hain ki samiksha duplicate aur ayogya naam hata rahi hai. Reuters ke anusaar 2025 se 13 crore se zyada naam hataaye gaye hain. Human Rights Watch ki Asia director Elaine Pearson ne prakriya radd karne ki maang ki. BJP ki taraf se Anurag Thakur ne rally ko 'political drama' kaha, jabki Amit Shah ne kaha ki vipaksh 'aur paanch saal' vipaksh mein hi rahega.

stories.title: Rally ki tareekh par BJP ka palatwaar: Hardeep Puri ne poocha '1984 mein kya kiya?', Delhi BJP pramukh bole — Sikh samaj ke zakhmon par namak
stories.summary: 1 November 1984 ke Sikh-virodhi dangon ki barsi par rally rakhne ko lekar BJP ne Congress ko ghera. Udhar vyapaariyon ke sangathan CTI ne Diwali se pehle bazaar mein rukaavat ki chinta jataayi thi.
body: ETV Bharat ke live blog ke mutabik Delhi BJP adhyaksh Harsh Malhotra ne rally ko Delhi ko 'bandhak' banaane ki koshish bataaya aur kaha ki is tareekh ko rally karna Sikh samudaay ke zakhmon par namak chhidakne jaisa hai. Kendriya mantri Hardeep Singh Puri ne Congress se 1984 ke dangon par sawaal poocha. Congress ki taraf se is aarop par seedha jawaab report mein darj nahi hai.

Isse pehle Chamber of Trade and Industry (CTI) ne rally ko Diwali ke baad tak taalne ki apeel ki thi aur bazaaron mein nuksaan ka anumaan diya tha, jiski swatantra pushti nahi hui. Rahul Gandhi ne ek din pehle video mein pradarshankaariyon se kaha tha ki march ke saath thodi khareedaari bhi karein taaki sthaniya vyapaariyon ko fayda ho.

Delhi Police ne kaha ki Ramlila Maidan ki rally ki anumati thi, lekin Minto Road se march ke liye aavedan nahi mila tha; phir bhi use 'facilitate' kiya gaya. ETV Bharat ke anusaar 4,000 se zyada police karmi, CAPF companiyan, 200 se adhik CCTV camere aur drone tainaat the, aur subah 10 se shaam 5 baje tak traffic diversion laagu raha.

stories.title: Chhattisgarh ke 26ve sthapna diwas par PM Modi: 'Maowad-prabhavit ilaake ab shanti aur vikas ke kendra'; Rs 51,000 crore ki rail pariyojanaon ka zikr
stories.summary: CM Vishnu Deo Sai ko likhe sandesh mein PM ne Bastar mein badlaav par garv jataaya aur kaha ki Maowad ke khilaaf nirnaayak karvaai ne vikas ka raasta khola.
body: ThePrint ki report ke mutabik Pradhan Mantri Narendra Modi ne Chhattisgarh ke 26ve sthapna diwas par Mukhya Mantri Vishnu Deo Sai ko patra likhkar rajya ke logon ko badhaai di. Unhone kaha ki Maowad ke khilaaf nirnaayak karvaai se vikas ka raasta khula hai aur kabhi Maowad-prabhavit rahe ilaake ab 'shanti, vishwas aur vikas' ke kendra ban rahe hain.

PM ne naye airports, Rs 51,000 crore se zyada ki railway pariyojanaon aur kalyaankaari yojanaon ka zikr kiya, aur kaha ki unhe Bastar mein ho rahe badlaavon par garv hai. 1 November ko Chhattisgarh samet kai rajyon ka sthapna diwas manaaya jaata hai, aur PM ne alag sandeshon mein in rajyon ko bhi shubhkaamnayein deen.

image.alt: Pradhan Mantri Narendra Modi ka official portrait (file photo)

editorial.title: Rally ka sandesh mazboot tha, par 'jail bhejenge' jaise vaade sansthaon ki ladaai ko nijee bana dete hain
body: Ramlila Maidan ki rally ne dikhaaya ki voter list ka mudda vipaksh ko ek mez par la sakta hai — Congress, SP, TMC, Shiv Sena (UBT) aur kai dal ek manch par the. Lekin jab ek sanvaidhanik pad par baithe vyakti ko 'jail' bhejne ka vaada manch se kiya jaata hai, to bahas prakriya se hatkar vyakti par aa jaati hai. Asli sawaal yeh hai ki 13 crore naam kis aadhaar par kate aur kitne galat kate — yeh saabit karna hi vipaksh ki sabse badi taakat hogi.

BJP ka 1984 ki barsi wala tark bhi apni jagah ek bhavnaatmak mudda hai, par voter list ke sawaalon ka jawaab nahi. Dono pakshon ke liye behtar hoga ki Supreme Court ki sunwaai aur Aayog ke aankdon par dhyaan kendrit rahe. Sadak ki raajneeti dabaav banaati hai; bharosa sirf paardarshita se lautega.

stories.title: Iran se baatcheet par Trump — 'theek chal rahi' par 'bharosemand nahi'; Rubio bole, hamle dobara shuru karne par faisla abhi nahi, Israel midterms ke baad ki taiyaari mein
stories.summary: Iran ne Hormuz kholne ke liye sharton ki lambi list rakhi hai — sanctions hatana, oil waiver bahaal karna aur US sainya maujoodgi kam karna. Ynet ke hawaale se Israel 3 November ke midterms ke baad naye daur ki taiyaari kar raha hai.
body: Al Jazeera ke explainer ke mutabik Iran ke videsh mantri Abbas Araghchi ki team Doha mein Qatari madhyasthon ke saath Hormuz Strait ko do din mein kholne ki yojana par baat kar rahi hai. Iran ki shartein hain: haal ke US pratibandh hatana, June ke oil waivers bahaal karna, ilaake mein US sena ki maujoodgi ghataana, Iran aur Oman dwara tay shipping raaston ko maanyata dena, aur Lebanon samet sabhi morchon par ladaai khatm karna. Qatar ke saath Pakistan bhi madhyasth hai.

Fox News ke live blog ke mutabik US Videsh Mantri Marco Rubio ne kaha ki Trump ne hamle dobara shuru karne par 'faisla nahi kiya' hai aur woh kootneetik hal pasand karte hain. Al Jazeera ke anusaar Rubio ne kaha ki baatcheet kabhi ruki hi nahi. Trump ne baatcheet ko 'theek' bataaya par Iran ke vaartakaaron ki vishwasniyata par sawaal uthaaya, aur kaha ki kuch Iranian thikaane abhi bhi 'nipatne' baaki hain. Iran ke suraksha pramukh Mohsen Rezaei ne daava kiya ki Washington sharton par raazi hone ke sanket de raha hai — US ne iski pushti nahi ki.

Doosri taraf tanaav ke sanket bhi hain. Araghchi ne kaha ki Iran ki sena pehle se zyada taiyaar hai, aur Rezaei ne 'naye hathiyaar' aur parmaanu siddhaant badalne par vichaar ki baat kahi. Ynet News ke hawaale se ek varishth Israeli adhikaari ne kaha ki Israel midterms ke turant baad sambhavit naye sangharsh ki taiyaari kar raha hai. Riyadh mein US Embassy ne Houthi hamlon ke beech Saudi Arabia mein Americans ko airports ke aaspaas saavdhaan rehne ko kaha.

image.alt: Iran ke videsh mantri Abbas Araghchi, IAEA ki ek purani baithak ki file photo

stories.title: France mein mehngaai aur police hinsa ke khilaaf laakhon sadak par; Paris, Lyon aur Toulouse mein police se jhadap
stories.summary: Sarkar ke mutabik 3.2 lakh log, jabki yuva sangathanon ke anusaar kareeb 5 lakh log jutey. Raashtrapati chunaav mein chhah mahine se kam bache hain aur Marine Le Pen polls mein aage hain.
body: Dawn par chhapi report ke mutabik Shanivaar ko France bhar mein Yellow Vest kaaryakarta, trade unions aur school-college ke chhaatr mehngaai, asamaanta aur police hinsa ke khilaaf sadkon par utre. Adhikaariyon ne 3.2 lakh logon ka anumaan diya, jinmein 70,000 Paris mein the, jabki yuva sangathanon ne desh bhar mein lagbhag 5 lakh aur Paris mein 2 lakh ka daava kiya.

Paris ke paas ek march ke ant mein police ne aansu gas aur lathi ka istemaal kiya; Paris police prefecture ke mutabik kuch sau 'dangaaiyon' ne adhikaariyon par hamla kiya, jismein ek Molotov cocktail bhi phenka gaya. Lyon mein bhi aansu gas chhodi gayi aur Toulouse mein ek anadhikrit pradarshan par water cannon chalaayi gayi. Report ke mutabik do hafte pehle ki ashaanti mein dukaanein looti gayi thi aur sarkaari imaaraton mein aag lagaayi gayi thi.
Yeh andolan aise samay ho raha hai jab France mein raashtrapati chunaav chhah mahine se kam door hain aur far-right neta Marine Le Pen opinion polls mein aage chal rahi hain.

image.alt: Paris ki sadkon par November 2023 ka ek alag pradarshan (pratinidhi file photo, is hafte ka nahi)

stories.title: North Korea ne cluster-bomb warheads ka test kiya, KCNA ka daava — 12-13 hectare ilaaka 'raakh' karne ki kshamata
stories.summary: Test Shanivaar ko hua; Kim Jong Un maujood nahi the. Seema par landmine dhamaake mein teen South Korean sainikon ke ghayal hone ke baad tanaav badha hua hai.
body: Dawn par chhapi report ke mutabik North Korea ki sarkaari samachar agency KCNA ne Ravivaar ko bataaya ki Shanivaar ko tactical ballistic missiles ke liye bane cluster-bomb warheads ka test kiya gaya. KCNA ka daava hai ki sabse ghani setting par yeh hathiyaar 12 se 13 hectare ilaake ko tabaah kar sakta hai. Missile Administration ke pramukh ne kaha ki units isi saal sabhi tarah ke warheads chunkar istemaal kar sakengi. Is baar Kim Jong Un test mein maujood nahi the.

Yeh test haal ke drone, torpedo aur hypersonic missile parikshanon ki kadi mein hai. Dono Koreas ki seema par ek landmine dhamaake mein teen South Korean sainik ghayal hue the; North Korea ne zimmedari se inkaar kiya hai aur seema ki kilebandi badhaane va loudspeaker abhiyaan dobara shuru karne ki baat kahi hai.

editorial.title: Iran baatcheet 'theek' bhi hai aur 'bharosemand nahi' bhi — yeh dohri bhasha khatre ki ghanti hai
body: Ek taraf Doha mein Hormuz kholne ki do din waali yojana par baat ho rahi hai, doosri taraf Washington, Tehran aur Tel Aviv teeno se jang ki taiyaari ke bayaan aa rahe hain. Jab Israel ke adhikaari khud kehte hain ki midterms ke baad naya daur ho sakta hai, to agla ek hafta kootneeti ke liye nirnaayak hai.

Bharat jaise tel-aayaatak desh ke liye Hormuz ka khulna sirf bhu-raajneeti nahi, rasoi aur petrol pump ka sawaal hai. Qatar aur Pakistan ki madhyasthata ko mauka milna chahiye; dono pakshon ki sharton mein lachilapan hi is sankat ka sabse sasta hal hai.

stories.title: Tyohaari maang se Maruti ki October mein ab tak ki sabse badi bikri — 2.76 lakh gaadiyan, export 59% uchhla; Tata 21% badha, Toyota 27% phisla
stories.summary: Navratri-Dussehra ke tyohaari season mein passenger vehicle bikri mein zabardast tezi. Tata Motors ki EV bikri 75% badhi, Mahindra ne record SUV bikri bataayi.
body: Rushlane ki report ke mutabik Maruti Suzuki ne October 2026 mein kul 2,76,120 gaadiyan bechi — saal-dar-saal 25% zyada aur company ka ab tak ka sabse bada maasik aankda. Gharelu passenger vehicle bikri 20.46% badhkar 2,12,384 rahi, jabki export 59.32% uchhalkar 49,872 ho gaya. Utility vehicles 26% badhe aur sabse zyada volume growth unhi se aayi.

Autocar India ke aankdon ke mutabik gharelu bazaar mein Tata Motors 73,894 units (+20.87%) ke saath doosre number par raha, Mahindra 73,338 (+2.39%) ke saath teesre par, jabki Hyundai 62,799 (+16.74%) aur Kia 33,462 (+13.22%) par rahe. Toyota ki bikri 26.67% gir gayi. Mahindra ne apni ab tak ki sabse badi maasik gharelu SUV bikri aur Kia ne record maasik bikri bataayi.

Auto India Daily ke anusaar Tata Motors ki kul PV bikri 23% badhkar 75,426 rahi aur EV bikri 75% uchhalkar 16,244 units tak pahunchi, jo kul volume ka lagbhag 21.5% hai. Autocar India ke mutabik yeh mahina Navratri aur Dussehra ki khareedaari ka tha, jabki Dhanteras aur Diwali November mein hain.

stories.title: UPI ne October mein banaaya record: 25.47 billion transactions, Rs 31.53 lakh crore ka len-den; pehli baar rozaana auasat Rs 1 lakh crore ke paar
stories.summary: NPCI ke aankdon ke mutabik volume saal-dar-saal 23% aur value 16% badhi. Rs 2,000 se upar ke kuch merchant payments par MDR laagu karne ki yojana Diwali ke baad tak taali gayi hai.
body: Entrackr ki report ke mutabik NPCI ke aankde dikhaate hain ki October 2026 mein UPI par 25.47 billion transactions hue, jinki kul value Rs 31.53 lakh crore rahi. September ke mukaable volume 5.8% aur value 7.4% badhi (October mein ek din zyada tha). Saal-dar-saal volume 23% aur value 16% upar rahi.

Rozaana auasat 822 million transactions aur Rs 1,01,707 crore raha — pehli baar daily value Rs 1 lakh crore ke paar gayi. Saath hi NPCI ne select merchant transactions par MDR (merchant discount rate) ka framework, jo 15 October se aana tha, Diwali ke baad tak taal diya hai; nayi tareekh alag se bataayi jaayegi. Is framework mein Rs 2,000 se upar ke kuch P2M payments par 0.4% charge (adhiktam Rs 300) ka prastaav hai, jabki Rs 2,000 tak ke aur person-to-person transfers isse bahar hain.

editorial.title: Gaadiyon aur UPI ke record achchhi khabar hain, par tyohaari tezi ka asli imtihaan Diwali ke baad hoga
body: Maruti ka record, Tata ki EV chhalaang aur UPI par rozaana Rs 1 lakh crore — yeh sab dikhaata hai ki tyohaari maang mazboot hai. Lekin isme Navratri-Dussehra ka mausami asar bhi shaamil hai, aur Toyota-Honda jaisi companiyon ki giravat batati hai ki tezi sab tak barabar nahi pahunchi.

Mehnga tel aur Hormuz ka sankat abhi bhi upbhokta ki jeb par dabaav daal sakte hain. Isliye December-January ke aankde batayenge ki yeh maang tikau hai ya sirf tyohaar ki chamak. UPI par MDR ka faisla bhi soch-samajhkar hona chahiye, taaki chhote vyapaariyon mein digital bhugtaan ka bharosa bana rahe.

stories.title: Hamilton T20I: Seifert ke 50 gend par 93 aur Phillips ke naabaad 65 se New Zealand ne 192 ka lakshya 18 over mein haasil kiya; India ne series 3-2 se jeeti
stories.summary: Glenn Phillips ne series mein 341 run banaakar bilateral T20I series ka naya record banaaya aur Player of the Series bane. Adam Milne (4/19) Player of the Match rahe.
body: India.com ki report ke mutabik Seddon Park mein paanchve aur aakhri T20I mein New Zealand ne India ko 7 wicket se haraaya. India ke 191/8 ke jawaab mein Kiwi team ne sirf 18 over mein 195/3 bana diye. Tim Seifert ne 50 gend par 93 run ki pari kheli, jabki Glenn Phillips 38 gend par 65 run banaakar naabaad lautey. Isse pehle India ki taraf se Ishan Kishan (32 gend, 61) aur kaptaan Shreyas Iyer (23 gend, 50) ne teesre wicket ke liye 93 run jode the.

Phillips ne series mein 82*, 70, 17, 107 aur 65* ke saath kul 341 run banaaye aur Phil Salt ke 331 run ka bilateral T20I series record tod diya. Woh ek bilateral T20I series mein 300 run paar karne waale pehle New Zealand ballebaaz bhi bane. Lagaataar do haar ke bawajood India ne series 3-2 se apne naam ki.

stories.title: Binance ka daava — chori hue $6.3 billion mein se kareeb 95% ki bharpaai, withdrawals phir shuru; FBI ne North Korea ki TraderTraitor unit ko zimmedar bataaya
stories.summary: Ise ab tak ki sabse badi digital chori bataaya ja raha hai. Trump ne kaha ki North Korea ki bhoomika abhi pakki nahi; North Korea aise aaropon se inkaar karta raha hai.
body: Dawn par chhapi report ke mutabik crypto exchange Binance se Guruvaar der raat lagbhag 20 minute mein kareeb $6.3 billion ke tokens chura liye gaye. Co-CEO Richard Teng ke mutabik hamla ek compromised laptop aur saboot mitaane waale malware se shuru hua. FBI ne Shanivaar ko North Korea ki state-sponsored unit TraderTraitor ko zimmedar thehraaya; TRM Labs aur Chainalysis ne bhi ise Pyongyang se jode gaye pichhle hamlon jaisa bataaya. North Korea aise aaropon se inkaar karta aaya hai, aur Trump ne kaha ki US ko abhi pakka nahi pata.

Binance ne Ravivaar ko kaha ki usne company ke paison se replacement tokens khareedkar chori ki kareeb 95% value (lagbhag $6 billion) ki bharpaai kar di hai, aur bachi 5% kam liquid assets mein hai. Iske liye uske $1 billion ke SAFU fund aur corporate treasury ka istemaal hua. Exchange ne pehle charan mein bitcoin, ether, XRP aur dogecoin samet 15 assets ke withdrawals Ravivaar se shuru karne ki baat kahi. Report ke anusaar Shukravaar tak kareeb $3 billion ke assets industry partners ki madad se freeze kiye ja chuke the.

stories.title: 'Ramayana: Part One' ki Day-1 advance booking India mein Rs 22.54 crore ke paar, 4.9 lakh tickets bike; film 5 November ko release
stories.summary: Sacnilk ke aankdon ke mutabik 12,631 shows; overseas advance kareeb $3.86 million. Nitesh Tiwari ki film mein Ranbir Kapoor, Yash aur Sai Pallavi hain.
body: Business Today ki report ke mutabik trade tracker Sacnilk ke anusaar Nitesh Tiwari ki 'Ramayana: Part One' ne pehle din ke liye India mein blocked seats milaakar Rs 22.54 crore (bina blocked seats Rs 18.77 crore) ki advance booking kar li hai. Kareeb 4.9 lakh tickets bik chuke hain aur 12,631 shows mein auasat occupancy 18% hai.

Overseas mein Films Discourse ke hawaale se 31 October tak lagbhag $3.86 million (kareeb Rs 32.5 crore) ki pre-sales hui hai. Ranbir Kapoor, Yash aur Sai Pallavi ki yeh film 5 November ko release ho rahi hai — yaani Diwali se pehle box office par bada muqaabla tay hai.

image.alt: Abhineta Ranbir Kapoor (April 2024 ki file photo)

editorial.title: 20 minute mein $6.3 billion ki chori batati hai ki crypto ki suraksha abhi bhi ek laptop jitni kamzor ho sakti hai
body: Binance ne tezi se bharpaai karke grahakon ka bharosa bachaane ki koshish ki hai, jo sarahniya hai. Lekin ek compromised laptop se itni badi chori yeh dikhaati hai ki duniya ke sabse bade exchanges bhi buniyaadi cyber suraksha mein chook kar sakte hain.

Bharat mein crypto mein paisa lagaane waale laakhon logon ke liye sabak saaf hai: exchange ka naam bada hona suraksha ki guarantee nahi. Niyamak sansthaon ko bhi exchanges ke liye reserve, audit aur cyber standards par spasht niyam banaane chahiye. (Yeh nivesh salah nahi hai.)
